column1: # German (de) catalog. Same format as `es.tsv`: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# German video-editing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI
# was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Like the German catalogs of the other Craft
# apps, text addresses the user informally ("du") and commands use the infinitive ("Projekt
# öffnen…"). Product, format and feature names (FilmCraft, ArtCraft, Lumetri, Essential Graphics,
# EDL, AAF…) keep their spelling. This catalog covers every menu, including the native macOS
# app menu; anything else is shown in English.
# Terms: track = Spur, bin = Ablage, marker = Marker, playhead = Abspielposition, In/Out = In-/Out-
